notes: Green Plains Inc (NASDAQ: GPRE) — Omaha-based ethanol + grain processing (CIK 1309402). Operates ~1.0 billion gallons/yr ethanol production capacity across ~10 plants. Diversifying into Ultra-High Protein (USP) feed (60% protein) using Fluid Quip MSC technology, and renewable corn oil. Fiscal year = calendar year. Reports in USD. Plant ownership consolidated through Green Plains Partners LP (acquired 2023). Volatile ethanol crush margins.

periods.notes: FY20: revenue $1.93B. EBITDA $-7M (pandemic ethanol demand collapse). Net loss $41M.
FY21: revenue $2.32B (+20%). EBITDA $75M. Net income $6M. Capital raises funded USP buildout.
FY22: revenue $3.55B (+53%). EBITDA $31M. Net loss $68M. Strong ethanol prices but cost inflation, USP startup losses.
FY23: revenue $3.43B. EBITDA $75M. Net loss $77M. Acquired remaining GPP units. Continued USP ramp.
FY24: revenue $2.50B (-27%). EBITDA $-25M (margin compression). Net loss $123M. Strategic review announced; idled high-cost plants. CEO transition.
